name: Bench Knee Tuck
steps: Lie flat on a bench, grip the edges near your head or hips, and extend your legs straight past the end.
Press your lower back firmly into the pad and brace your abs.
Exhale as you bend your knees and pull your thighs smoothly inward toward your chest, curling your hips slightly at the top.
Extend your legs slowly back out straight without letting your heels drop below bench height.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed against the bench as your legs lengthen.
Pull with controlled abdominal contraction rather than swinging your legs rapidly.
